 Note: At the moment, individual quest pages won't work due to quests not having proper names. For now quests should be described in the respective NPC page.

After delivering [[Horadric]]'s letter to the blacksmith [[Krezvold]] he will ask you to kill some [[Slime|Slimes]]. To do this he gives you a broken [[rusty sword]], two [[Energy potion|Energy potions]], and a [[whetstone]]. You are meant to use the whetstone to repair the sword and then kill the Slimes with it.  Afterward you need only bring the [[green jelly]] back to the [[Blacksmith]].  Only after you complete this Quest will you be able to trade with the blacksmith.
